title: Artifacts example test: retry only the docker compose pull step
answers: flaky CI when Docker Hub authentication times out pulling postgres
retry transient docker pull failures in the mlflow artifacts test
docker hub rate limit or timeout breaks the artifacts example integration test
how to retry docker compose pull without retrying application failures
body:
Symptom: The artifacts example integration test fails intermittently when Docker Hub's auth endpoint times out while pulling an image such as postgres, even though the example code itself is fine.
Root cause: tests/tracking/test_mlflow_artifacts.py:test_mlflow_artifacts_example ran no pull retry, so the transient registry error failed the whole test.
Fix pattern: Run `docker compose pull --ignore-buildable` in a loop of 3 attempts before `./build.sh` and `docker compose run`, sleeping attempt*5 seconds between tries (5s, then 10s), and exit 1 after the third failure.
Constraints: Only the pull is retried; build and application (`docker compose run ... python example.py`) failures are not retried. Keep the loop before the build and run, and keep `set -e` so non-pull failures stop immediately.
applies: Only the shell script in test_mlflow_artifacts_example; does not apply to other Docker-based tests unless they copy this pattern.
says: The artifact example test fails intermittently because image downloads time out.
Transient registry connection timeouts keep breaking our continuous integration test runs.
Please retry fetching container images when running the artifact sample pipeline.
Retry registry downloads on network glitches without masking actual application test failures.
Automated artifact test builds fail randomly due to registry authentication timeouts.
search: In tests/tracking/test_mlflow_artifacts.py:test_mlflow_artifacts_example, transient Docker Hub authentication timeouts are handled by retrying only the docker compose pull step before building and running. The script executes docker compose pull --ignore-buildable in a loop of three attempts before ./build.sh and docker compose run, sleeping attempt*5 seconds (5s, then 10s) between attempts and exiting 1 after the third failure. Under set -e, only image pulls are retried, while build and application failures from docker compose run stop immediately without retry.
